title: ۴ تیپ مشتری ناخن: تو کدومی؟
format: Same cartoon blob world, cast and pacing DNA as the best-performing scenario 01 (relatable client behaviours, one gag per scene, hook number sticker, wholesome payoff) but a NEW mechanic: 'which type are you?' identity-quiz with four client types, each with a drawn badge. Not a phrase list.
goal: Fix what the insights of scenario 01 showed: strong skip-rate and saves/shares, but 0 comments, only 2 follows, and most drop-off in the first seconds. Targets: instant hook (no intro), low-friction comment (emoji per type), concrete follow reason (series promise + next-episode tease), saveable utility card, specific tag CTA. 28-34 s.
insightsBasis: Scenario 01 insights (1,727 views, avg watch 14 s of 36 s, skip rate lower than usual, share/save/repost rates higher than usual, comment rate 0%, 2 follows, 62% Reels tab + 34% Explore = mostly non-followers). Small sample: treat as directional.
growth: Hook line is a curiosity question answered by the whole video; first frame already funny; no logo/title animation longer than 0.8 s.
Comment mechanic = reply with the type's emoji (clock, camera, friend, can) — one tap, no typing effort. Pin the same ask.
Follow reason: visible series promise + 'next episode' tease in the end-card and caption.
Save mechanic: the utility card scene (3 s, readable).
Share mechanic: 'tag type three' is specific; keep one targeted tag ask.

cast.name: Nailie
cast.desc: round pink blob, tiny nail-brush antenna with a gel-drop tip, big glossy eyes, deadpan patience

cast.name: Client
cast.desc: round peach-cream blob with a small bottle-cap tuft, expressive brows; shown in four behaviours

cast.name: Friend
cast.desc: small lavender blob with big opinions, whispers into Client's ear

scenes.idea: NO slow intro: frame 1 is already the funniest image. Nailie flips a tiny notebook toward the camera with big hand-written nicknames scribbling themselves out while Client sits oblivious and smiling; giant sticker '۴ تیپ مشتری' slams in within 0.8 s. Fast push-in, sparkle trails. Caption text visible from 0.2 s.

Client strolls in with a coffee, drawn clock icon pops above her; Nailie's wall clock shows 40 minutes ago with a tiny 'ترافیک بود' excuse bubble; then Client says 'ten minutes please' while holding up ten fingers and Nailie's eye twitches. Clock hands whirl, camera whip-pan between faces. Type-1 icon: drawn clock badge.

scenes.text: چهل تا عکس؛ میگه عین همین!
scenes.idea: Client opens a phone and an avalanche of screenshots pours out of it like a waterfall of different nail styles; Nailie gets buried to her antenna; Client points at one photo: 'exactly this!' while every photo is totally different. Type-2 icon: drawn camera badge. Speed lines, screen shake on each photo thud.

scenes.text: با دوستش میاد؛ هر دقیقه یه نظر!
scenes.idea: Client arrives with a tiny Friend blob who whispers in her ear; the design on a mock nail changes every two seconds in a jump-cut loop (flower, stripes, gems, stripes again); Nailie's brush antenna spins like a helicopter, Friend gives a thumbs up each time. Type-3 icon: drawn two-heads badge. Whip-cut rhythm.

scenes.text: ناخن به‌جای ابزار؛ میگه خودش شکست!
scenes.idea: Client opens a soda can with her nail, pops a sticker off a box, scrapes a label; a tiny crack zigzags across the nail in slow motion with comic 'crack' lettering; she turns innocently: 'it broke by itself!' while Nailie's eyes slowly turn to the camera (deadpan). Type-4 icon: drawn can badge (callback to earlier episodes).

scenes.text: ولی با یه دستت درد نکنه… دلمون آب می‌شه!
scenes.idea: Warm light sweep; Client shows the finished glossy nails in macro and says thank you with hearts in her eyes; Nailie melts into a puddle and all the earlier chaos (clock, screenshots, friend, can) float away as tiny doodles; sparkles and hearts, camera crane-up.

SAVE-WORTHY UTILITY CARD, clean and readable for 3 s: a neat rounded card slides in titled 'کارت مشتری ایده‌آل' with three drawn icons appearing one by one (clock, single photo, hand-stop sign with check marks); a big bookmark icon bounces in the corner. Nailie nods approvingly. Text must stay on screen long enough to read.

scenes.text: تو کدومی؟ با ایموجیش جواب بده!
scenes.idea: The four type badges (clock, camera, two-heads, can) line up as a row on screen with matching little emoji hints shown as drawn icons; Nailie points at the viewer; a send arrow flies. End-card (3 s): 'قسمت بعد: ۴ تیپ ناخن‌کار' + big 'فالو کن' pill + @ayda.nailroom, with the series promise 'هر هفته یه قسمت'.
